title: LattePanda 3 Delta
notes: 125 x 78 mm, four 3.2 mm holes 118 x 71 mm apart, 3.5 mm from the edges (official KiCad footprint in the LattePanda KiCad library, and official 3D model V1.1).

l = L is the end with the three USB-A ports (towards the frame in upright landscape and shelf portrait), l = 0 the end with the HDMI, Ethernet, headphone and USB-C ports. s = 0 is the edge with the RTC battery, the Arduino-side GPIO header and the power button, which faces the back plate.
The microSD and nano SIM slot is under the board at the s = S edge, with the 12 V input header and, under the board, the display and touch panel connectors.
Under the board are the two M.2 slots, the cards in them and their standoffs (the deepest, 5.1 mm below the board).
Standoffs 8 mm tall: the M.2 standoffs reach 5.1 mm below the board. 6 mm across: the nearest part under the board is 3.2 mm from a hole centre.
Two rows of windows, clear of the standoffs.
